query:
INSERT INTO dok_hashes(dok_id, hash_strat_id, value, mime_id) 
        SELECT $1, hs.id, inpt.value, m.id 
        FROM
            UNNEST($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[]) as inpt(strat, value, mime),
            hash_strategy hs, 
            mime as m
        WHERE 
            hs.value = inpt.strat AND
            m.value = inpt.mime
